identity.canonical_root: 國立屏東科技大學/內埔校本部/buildings/npust-yukang-library

scope: Independent final source/visual-benefit and unchanged original mesh/material-scope review. Not a full-building reconstruction, calibrated color survey, fabrication approval or authorization to publish.

decision.summary: 原圖與五圖、同角中性對照已逐張親看。有限三排五跨窗背及前柱梁的材料區分清楚，但只屬正中央小幅改善；左斜微弱，右／背／頂幾乎中性。此窄範圍值得保留，不能擴稱全樓高精度彩色或藉收益不足擴染未證區。

personally_viewed.finding: 完整教育部 2000×1333 活動原圖；中央三排五跨窗、六道淺色磁磚柱與名牌梁可見。灰色窗間不透明帶與細框不等於玻璃；布幔遮兩高翼、人群遮階梯。金字與細磁磚縫未存在原網格，沒有新增。
原始 mono 預覽親看，原有粗化層高、窗格、兩翼、屋頂與鋼架不是本次重建範圍；不與最終照明不同的舊圖作像素效益比較。
中央十五個原凹窗背面的深灰藍與六柱／名牌梁淺色正面可辨；整樓仍以中性為主。與同角 mono 比較有小而真實的前中央辨識改善，不稱全樓材料復原。
中央著色面僅小斜角可見；側面鋼架、普通窗、頂部與大翼全中性，收益微弱但沒有擴染。
幾乎全中性；背／側可見窗和外牆未由正面照片推色。
背中央及兩翼、外斜鋼架保持中性，不因正面證據借染背玻璃。
屋頂與既有 PV 群組保持中性；本次沒有屋頂材質或片數驗證。
同交付 scene 的相機／燈／render 設定，僅暫將所有 polygon material_index 設 0、不 save scene。與 final front 比較，實有局部窗背和前柱梁差異；不是歷史預覽，也不是全館提升。

independent_geometry_material_checks.native_STL: Fresh read-only Blender extraction; all 7106 oriented triangles form an exact coordinate bijection (cyclic vertex starts allowed, reversed winding not allowed), all original material indices zero.
independent_geometry_material_checks.STL_3MF: All 7106 triangles preserve original coordinates, sequence and winding. All three corner properties are equal to the independently reconstructed material index. No subdivision, extra geometry or reassigned mixed face.
independent_geometry_material_checks.source_selection_note: The source canonical_vertices lists are sorted/unoriented coordinate sets; they were checked only as coordinate sets. Exact winding/order was independently taken from raw STL and compared to actual native and 3MF, not inferred from those lists.
independent_geometry_material_checks.finite_scope_method: All three float32-source vertices must lie on the individual bounded plane, within 0.0002 mm tolerance, with actual cross-product normal -Y. No centroid-only or global bbox selection.

approved_finite_regions.windows: 15 backs on y=-24.81; x centers [-11.2,-5.6,0,5.6,11.2] at scale 1.2, finite intervals (center +/-2.45)*1.2; z bases [3.4,7.8,12.2], finite intervals [1.6+base*1.2,1.6+(base+1.85)*1.2]. 30 complete triangles /195.8039834461215 mm².
approved_finite_regions.columns: Six front planes y=-29.61; x centers [-14,-8.4,-2.8,2.8,8.4,14], finite x=(center +/-0.575)*1.2, z=[4.36,20.8]. 12 triangles.
approved_finite_regions.beam: Only front y=-30.66, x=[-18,18], z=[19.72,21.16]. 2 triangles. Together with columns:14 triangles /141.6527949497231 mm².
approved_finite_regions.excluded: All 7062 other faces: gray opaque inter-window walls, fine window frames, column sides, beam bottom/top, unknown glazing, banners, two high wings, rear/sides, steel X braces, steps, base, roof/PV. No centroid selection or new triangle cutting to rescue cross-boundary gray-wall patches.

color_interpretation.limits: Uncalibrated opaque material-family proxies; not true optical transparency, measured paint codes, exact photographic illumination, fine ceramic joints or exact real pane count.

source_date_and_version.metadata: Independent full decode and root/nested EXIF DateTime/Original/Digitized/offset checks found no date values; no XMP packet. No shutter year inferred from page or construction dates.
source_date_and_version.cross_year_geometry: The inherited model combines 1991/2012/105 academic year/2024 orthophoto/2026 page evidence and bounded image-based estimates. The front-only material layer does not certify whole-building 2026 condition.

manufacturing_limits: Original topology remains single closed oriented surface with exact source geometry; this is not physical print evidence.
Historical QA was read and preserved, not recomputed as a new material-only manufacturing approval: 148 sampled layers and 3973 original polygons retain 3179 >1% loss observations.

Historical dense testing documented 2996 sub-0.8 mm first-solid segments on 107 very shallow backed relief bars (about 0.264 mm). They may merge or disappear in fabrication; do not claim a new all-thin-features PASS.

Historical roof/frame support intersections include partial support (about 36.36% at upper steel-frame interface and 89.59% central curved cover), not an engineering bearing calculation or support-free guarantee.
No physical print, slicer toolpath, structural safety or calibrated dimensional survey has been performed by this appearance review.

technical_evidence_scope.builder_mutation_save_reopen: Both delivery and independent builder reports record real material and vertex edit/save/reopen plus saved scene front re-render; independently read and matched by reviewer. These experiments are separately attributed to builder, not falsely claimed to have been repeated by reviewer.
technical_evidence_scope.reviewer_archive_execution: Reviewer independently extracted 11 actual rebuild-source members, checked each byte against delivery, ran build plus strict 3MF edit-save/read exchange in the private extraction, and compared resulting 3MF/palette/map bytes. Did not repeat five Blender renders.

package_gate: These two final independent QA files must be included byte-exact in appearance checksums and the actual final ZIP. A separate actual-member/CRC/checksum/source-exclusion receipt must be produced after packaging; this visual PASS alone is not ZIP or publication closure.
